The HPPSC Assistant Professor Anthropology selection process includes the following stages:
Paper I – Objective Type Screening Test Paper II – Descriptive Subject Aptitude Test Document Verification Personality Test
Paper I will be conducted as a Computer Based Test or offline screening test. It will carry 100 marks and have a duration of one hour.
The detailed syllabus for Paper II will be uploaded separately on the official HPPSC website.
One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for every incorrect answer in Paper I. If more than one answer is marked
it will be treated as incorrect and the same penalty will apply. Candidates who do not want to answer a question must select option “E”. If no option is selected
one-fourth of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted.
The Personality Test will carry 30 marks and will be held at the HPPSC office in Shimla. Final ranking will be determined using the marks obtained in the Subject Aptitude Test and Personality Test.
how_to_apply: Visit the HPPSC official website at https://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.
Click on the Apply Online link available on the homepage.
Open the One Time Registration for Examinations page.
Complete the new registration process if you have not registered previously.
Log in to the OTR portal using your registered credentials.
Select the Assistant Professor Anthropology advertisement from the list of live advertisements.
Enter the required personal, educational and category details.
Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting documents.
Preview the application and verify that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
Pay the examination fee through the prescribed online payment method.
Submit the application and save a copy for future reference.

Candidates should check every field carefully before final submission. Once submitted, the application generally cannot be corrected or modified except in circumstances permitted under the applicable HPPSC rules.

content_sections.heading: HPPSC Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies is tentative and may be increased or decreased by the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the following qualifications as of the closing date of the online application: A good academic record with at least 55% marks , or its equivalent under the applicable grading system, in a Master’s degree in Anthropology from a recognized Indian university. An equivalent degree from a foreign university recognized by the Government of India is also acceptable. Candidates must have cleared the eligibility test for Assistant Professor, such as NET conducted by UGC or CSIR , or a similar test accredited by the State Public Service Commission. NET, SLET or SET will remain the minimum eligibility requirement, subject to the exemptions provided for eligible Ph.D. degree holders under the applicable rules. SC, ST and OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates: Relaxation from 55% to 50%. Physically and visually handicapped candidates: Relaxation from 55% to 50%. Eligible Ph.D. holders who passed their Master’s degree before September 1991: Relaxation from 55% to 50%. Candidates who registered for an M.Phil. or Ph.D. programme before 11 July 2009 may be exempted from NET, SLET or SET, subject to fulfilment of the prescribed conditions, including: The Ph.D. degree must have been awarded in regular mode. The Ph.D. thesis must have been evaluated by at least two external examiners. An open Ph.D. viva voce must have been conducted. The candidate must have published at least two research papers from the Ph.D. work, including at least one paper in a refereed journal. The candidate must have made at least two conference or seminar presentations based on the Ph.D. work. Compliance with these conditions must be certified by the competent university authority. Knowledge of the customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh and suitability for appointment under the conditions prevailing in the state is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit prescribed for HPPSC Assistant Professor Anthropology Recruitment 2026 is: A relaxation of five years in the upper age limit is admissible to eligible bonafide candidates belonging to the following Himachal Pradesh categories, subject to the conditions specified in the notification: SC of Himachal Pradesh ST of Himachal Pradesh OBC of Himachal Pradesh Wards of Freedom Fighters of Himachal Pradesh Persons with disabilities of Himachal Pradesh Age relaxation for Himachal Pradesh Government employees and Ex-Servicemen of Himachal Pradesh will be provided according to the applicable government instructions. Candidates of reserved categories belonging to other states will be treated as unreserved candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under HPPSC Assistant Professor Anthropology Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HPPSC has announced 5 vacancies for Assistant Professor in Anthropology. All five vacancies are under the unreserved category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 16 October 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for an HPPSC Assistant Professor Anthropology Job Trainee?
faq.answer: The selected Job Trainee will receive fixed monthly emoluments of Rs.35,000.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for HPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The prescribed age limit is 18 to 45 years as of 1 January 2026. Applicable age relaxation will be provided according to the notification and government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates should hold a Master’s degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade and should have qualified NET, SLET or SET, subject to the prescribed exemptions.

faq.question: Q6. Is NET compulsory for HPPSC Assistant Professor Anthropology posts?
faq.answer: NET, SLET or SET is generally required. However, candidates holding a qualifying Ph.D. degree may receive an exemption if they fulfil all the conditions mentioned in the notification and applicable regulations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for HPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment?
faq.answer: A uniform examination fee of Rs.600 applies to all candidates, irrespective of category or gender.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for HPPSC Assistant Professor Anthropology?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of an objective screening test, a descriptive Subject Aptitude Test, document verification and a Personality Test.
